style.prompt: Create a polished 15-second vertical 9:16 candle product advertisement. Photorealistic intimate minimalist premium tabletop scene in warm evening light, amber highlights and soft natural shadows, quiet cozy room softly blurred behind. The single hero product must stay identical throughout: a clear transparent straight-sided cylindrical glass jar with a flat base, filled with ivory wax, exactly ONE centered wick with a small gently flickering flame, absolutely no label, no branding, no lid, no other candles. Realistic glass reflections and wax texture. Restrained graceful camera movement, slow dolly-in and subtle lateral slide, no abrupt movements. Timeline: 0–4 seconds an elegant medium close-up establishes the entire jar on a warm wooden table; 4–10 seconds move gently closer to the glowing single wick and clear rim while keeping the candle recognizable; 10–15 seconds settle into a composed hero shot with generous negative space above the candle. On-screen typography must be clean, elegant and correctly spelled: show exactly 'A little evening calm' during seconds 2–8, then fade it away; show exactly 'Find your glow' during seconds 11–15 and hold through the final frame. Warm ivory readable typography centered in the upper negative space, no extra text or logos. Audio: soft delicate solo piano instrumental, slow peaceful melody, low volume, subtle warm sustain, gentle fade out at the end. NO voice, NO speech, NO vocals, NO narration, NO percussion. Serene refined understated advertising mood, natural flame behavior, consistent product proportions.
